description: FULL BODY: A Malaysian man in his early 40s, sharp features, short black hair. He is wearing a crisp, formal dark blue Royal Malaysia Police (PDRM) uniform including a peaked cap, epaulettes, and polished black boots. He stands tall with an authoritative posture.

FULL BODY: An elderly Malaysian woman in her late 60s with a gentle face. She is wearing a traditional floral patterned Baju Kurung in soft pastel colors and a simple white tudung (headscarf). She wears modest black sandals.

FULL BODY: A featureless, anonymous human silhouette rendered in translucent digital glitch textures. The figure is void of facial features and wears a dark hooded sweatshirt. Subtle lines of code and glowing red binary numbers flow across the surface of the figure.
